cl.x: Provide Abelflex where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2026, Version 01.04).
A flexible, lightweight, closed cell, cross-linked, polyethylene foam expansion joint and space filler. Used in concrete and brickwork, Abelflex is compressible and has excellent recovery properties.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
s: Ideal as a gap filler and bond breaker for floor and wall expansion joints, filling systems for roads, motorways, bridges, brick and block walls, concrete and automotive applications
In joints where polystyrene or bitumen impregnated fillers have been used, Abelflex is ideal as a bondbreaker. Often necessary due to sealant incompatib-ility with these forms of fillers
Suitable as a back-up filler for most elastomeric joint sealants
Ideal for stopping contaminants such as soil and debris entering the expansion slots and joints

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools
s: 1. Attach to concrete with general purpose construction adhesive or a caulking compound during erection of pre-cast concrete panels.
2. Insert into expansion joints, tearing off the zip to leave a pre-formed well for installation of the sealant compound such as butyl, polysulphide, polyurethane, acrylic and silicone sealants.

3. Zipping - slit through 90% of the thickness to a prescribed depth (standard 10mm) following curing. The zip can readily be torn off, leaving a pre-formed well for installation of the sealant or caulking compound.
